+// EOL describes the support lifecycle of an OS release.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has passed its end date.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether an applicable extended support phase has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// MajorVersionString strips an optional epoch and minor version from a version.
+// It lives in config so Distro can use it without a config/util import cycle.
+func MajorVersionString(version string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(version, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		version = version[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(version, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		version = version[:i]
+	}

+}

+var eolDates = map[string]map[string][2]string{

+		"14.10": {"2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"}, "21.04": {"2022-01-30", ""},
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9": {"2022-06-30", ""}, "10": {"2024-06-30", ""}, "8": {"2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": {"2021-05-30", ""}, "3.11": {"2021-11-30", ""},

+		"10": {"2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	},

+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for a modeled family and release.
+func GetEOL(family, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	dates, found := eolDates[family][release]
+	if !found {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	standard, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[0])
+	extended := time.Time{}
+	if dates[1] != "" {
+		extended, _ = time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[1])
+	}
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: standard, ExtendedSupportUntil: extended}, true
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOL(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct{ family, release, standard, extended string }{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"}, {Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""}, {RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""}, {CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""}, {Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"}, {Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"}, {Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"}, {Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"}, {FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""}, {FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		got, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release)
+		if !found || got.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.standard || (c.extended == "") != got.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || (c.extended != "" && got.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.extended) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %+v, found %v", c.family, c.release, got, found)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}, {"unknown", "1"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected EOL for %s %s", c.family, c.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLEndDatesAreExclusive(t *testing.T) {
+	e, _ := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "14.04")
+	for _, c := range []struct {
+		now                string
+		standard, extended bool
+	}{
+		{"2019-04-30", false, false}, {"2019-05-01", true, false}, {"2024-04-30", true, false}, {"2024-05-01", true, true},
+	} {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", c.now)
+		if e.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) != c.standard || e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) != c.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s: %+v", c.now, e)
+		}
+	}
+	noExtended, _ := GetEOL(RedHat, "7")
+	if noExtended.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(time.Now()) {
+		t.Fatal("absent extended support considered ended")
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+func eolWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == config.Raspbian || family == config.ServerTypePseudo {
+		return nil
+	}
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(family, release)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", family, release)}
+	}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+	if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan
+
+import (
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended."}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site."}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "9", "2024-01-01", nil}, {config.ServerTypePseudo, "9", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", c.now)
+		got := eolWarnings(c.family, c.release, now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, c.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", c.family, c.release, got, c.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+		"18.04": {"2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"}, "14.04": {"2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		"14.10": {"2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"}, "21.04": {"2022-01-30", ""},
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9": {"2022-06-30", ""}, "10": {"2024-06-30", ""}, "8": {"2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": {"2021-05-30", ""}, "3.11": {"2021-11-30", ""},
+		"3.12": {"2022-05-30", ""}, "3.9": {"2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": {"2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"}, "12": {"2023-12-31", ""},
+		"10": {"2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for a modeled family and release.
+func GetEOL(family, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	dates, found := eolDates[family][release]
+	if !found {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	standard, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[0])
+	extended := time.Time{}
+	if dates[1] != "" {
+		extended, _ = time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[1])
+	}
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: standard, ExtendedSupportUntil: extended}, true
+}

+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},

+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		got, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release)
+		if !found || got.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.standard || (c.extended == "") != got.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || (c.extended != "" && got.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != c.extended) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %+v, found %v", c.family, c.release, got, found)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, c := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}, {"unknown", "1"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(c.family, c.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected EOL for %s %s", c.family, c.release)

+}
+
+func TestEOLEndDatesAreExclusive(t *testing.T) {
+	e, _ := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "14.04")
+	for _, c := range []struct {
+		now                string
+		standard, extended bool
+	}{
+		{"2019-04-30", false, false}, {"2019-05-01", true, false}, {"2024-04-30", true, false}, {"2024-05-01", true, true},
+	} {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", c.now)
+		if e.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) != c.standard || e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) != c.extended {
+			t.Errorf("%s: %+v", c.now, e)
+		}
+	}
+	noExtended, _ := GetEOL(RedHat, "7")
+	if noExtended.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(time.Now()) {
+		t.Fatal("absent extended support considered ended")
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+)
+
+func eolWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == config.Raspbian || family == config.ServerTypePseudo {
+		return nil
+	}
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(family, release)
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", family, release)}
+	}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+	if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02"))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan
+

+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"

+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended."}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site."}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.RedHat, "9", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: redhat Release: 9'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "9", "2024-01-01", nil}, {config.ServerTypePseudo, "9", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", c.now)
+		got := eolWarnings(c.family, c.release, now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, c.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", c.family, c.release, got, c.want)
